tables.reason: Single product-master sheet: one row per unique product code/name, with currency, selling unit, standard price-list attributes and a pre-tax price plus explicit tax fields.

columns.name: 상품코드
columns.reason: Header means product code; 12 unique values for 12 rows, values 00470001–00470012, stored with leading zeros and must remain text.

columns.name: 상품명
columns.reason: Header means product name; one distinct customer-facing name per product row (테스트 상품 1–12).

columns.name: 통화
columns.reason: Header means currency; every row explicitly contains the ISO code KRW, an explicit source fact rather than an inferred country convention.

columns.name: 단위
columns.reason: Header means unit/UOM; every row explicitly contains PCS, which is a canonical sell-unit value.

columns.name: 가격표
columns.reason: Header means price list; every row explicitly contains the price-list name standard.

columns.name: 세전 가격
columns.reason: Header explicitly means pre-tax price; all 12 rows are populated with numeric amounts 25,000–36,000. The adjacent explicit tax-inclusion flag is '아니오' (No), consistent with this being a VAT-exclusive amount.

columns.name: 세금 포함
columns.reason: Header means tax included; every row explicitly says '아니오' (No), so this price record is VAT-exclusive and vat_included should be false.

columns.name: 세율
columns.reason: Header means tax rate; every row explicitly contains 5%, which should be represented as the numeric fraction 0.05.

columns.name: 바코드
columns.reason: Header means barcode; 12 unique EAN-13-like values such as 0880123100000, with a leading zero that must be preserved as text.

changes_from_draft: Added /product_name from 상품명 (required by the contract, was unmapped in the draft).
Replaced the fabricated constant /currency = THB with the explicit per-row source value 통화 = KRW (upper/trim), no FX conversion.
Added /unit/sell_unit from 단위 = PCS via unit_normalize; /unit/pack_size left unmapped (null) because no pack-size evidence exists — not inferred from 'PCS'.
Added /barcode from 바코드 cast to string so the leading zero of the 13-digit EAN codes is preserved.
/sku now trims and casts 상품코드 to string to preserve the leading zeros of 00470001–00470012; removed the draft fallback doubt, 상품코드 is clearly the product code key.

Added the /prices collection from a second view of the same sheet (source price_rows, linked on 상품코드), carrying 가격표 -> price_list ('standard'), 세전 가격 -> amount, 세율 '5%' -> vat_rate 0.05, 세금 포함 '아니오' -> vat_included false.
Set record dedupe to /sku (keep first) instead of an empty key list.

/prices/*/effective_from, /prices/*/effective_to, /unit/pack_size, /brand, /category, /description, /inventory and /promotions have no source columns in this workbook and are intentionally left unmapped rather than filled with guesses.
/status is left unmapped: no status column exists, so the contract default 'active' applies rather than a fabricated constant.
attributes_passthrough stays true: the remaining row-level columns (가격표, 세전 가격, 세금 포함, 세율) are retained under /attributes so no supplied data is lost.

단위 = 'PCS' on all 12 rows: canonical sell unit.

세율 = '5%' on all rows: explicit source tax rate -> 0.05 fraction.

Header 상품명 = product name; 12 distinct customer-facing names (테스트 상품 1–12), no blanks.
